Subject: POC evaluation roadmap & benchmarks (MAP kickoff)

Hi Elena and Michael,

Thanks again for the call last week — excited to get the POC moving. Attached is a very short draft MAP and an initial benchmark plan that we usually run for clinical extraction POCs. The goal for this thread is to lock down:

- Success criteria (pass/fail thresholds)
- Concrete bench tasks and data slices to test (examples below)
- Who owns prompts/evaluations on both sides
- Timeline to a decision/close (preferred 6–8 week POC)

Quick asks to help us prepare before the kickoff meeting:
1) Confirm three priority use-cases you want exercised in the POC (e.g., discharge summary key-value extraction, ER triage note normalization, med reconciliation).
2) Share the names/emails of the people who will own labeling, data extracts, and IT access.
3) Flag any hard constraints (latency, throughput, PHI handling) we should bake into the bench.

Proposed kickoff: Thursday, Jun 17 at 10:00 AM PT — 30 minutes. If that works we will send a calendar invite and a short agenda.

Attachments: [Attachment: redwood_MAP_v0.1.xlsx (spreadsheet)], [Attachment: benchmark_plan.md (markdown)]

Thanks — I’ll coordinate the MAP doc and capture owners.

Subject: Re: POC evaluation roadmap & benchmarks (MAP kickoff)

Hi Jonas — thanks for the note and the draft. Thursday at 10:00 AM PT works for our team.

Priority use-cases (high->low):
- Discharge summary key-value extraction (we need high recall on allergies and med lists)
- ER triage note triage-category normalization (rapid triage decisioning)
- Procedure code suggestion for cath lab notes (spot-check quality)

Success criteria (initial):
- Extraction F1 >= 0.88 on held-out gold set for discharge summaries
- Median generation latency < 300 ms for single-request inference
- End-to-end throughput to support ~200 concurrent requests with 99th pct latency under 1s
- Cost target: average token cost <= $0.02 for responses at expected prompt shapes

Owners at Synapse:
- Elena Ortiz — Executive sponsor / product owner (me)
- Michael Chen — Data & ML partner (cc’d)
- Sarah Park <sarah.park@synapsehealth.com> — Labeling lead / clinical SME (will join kickoff)
- Carlos Ruiz <carlos.ruiz@synapsehealth.com> — Infra / SRE (may join depending on scope)

We can share a small sample set (de-identified) ahead of the meeting — will coordinate with Carlos on extracts. Looking forward to the kickoff and seeing your benchmark tasks.

— Elena
